mapping:

  frame:
    question: "LT Corwin posted, with jokes, details from EN2 Reyna's own public fundraising page in #wardroom: a records matter or routine moderation?"
    owner: "me, for what I report and how I moderate; the CO owns any inquiry or discipline"
    my_role: "decide: I moderate under the charter and report records misuse under para 6"
    values: [usp_privacy, oversight_candor, institutional_credibility, duty_to_individual]

  fit:
    case: OVS-301
    rating: close
    why: "Same ship, people, chat and duties. One difference the card names: the details come from the sailor's own public page."

  compare:
    - ref: c1
      live: "Corwin keeps the records, but his posts link and quote Reyna's own public page; Reyna has no request open"
      here: missing
      matters: decides
      why: "The card's report rested on a custodian using a file. No file is used here."
    - ref: c2
      live: "para 6 is unchanged, but no record or its contents was used"
      here: missing
      matters: decides
      why: "The instruction reaches records misuse, and there is none for it to reach."
    - ref: c3
      live: "the page is public, by Reyna's own hand, shared 212 times; the posts add 14 readers"
      here: weaker
      matters: weighs
      why: "Repeating what he published adds little exposure. The jokes are unkind, which the charter's civility rule covers."
    - ref: c4
      live: "no earlier para 6 report or flag involving Corwin"
      here: same
      matters: "no"
      why: "With no report in question, a first lapse changes nothing."
    - ref: c5
      live: "the XO supervises the personnel office and is on his phone tonight"
      here: same
      matters: "no"
      why: "There is no report to ask him about."
    - ref: c6
      live: "pinned charter: keep it civil; what is said here stays here; the moderator does not report members' talk"
      here: same
      matters: weighs
      why: "With no records misuse, the charter governs: civility, handled in the chat."

  new:
    - live: "Reyna put the same details on a public fundraising page himself on 09 Oct"
      favors: [A]
      value: usp_privacy
      matters: decides
      why: "Nothing held in confidence was disclosed; the card's first would-change item holds."

  carry:
    relation: flips
    settled: "The card's first would-change item holds: the details were public by Reyna's own hand and Corwin repeated them. Nothing held in confidence was disclosed, so para 6 has nothing to reach."
    open: "How to handle the unkindness. The card leaves it to routine moderation, so I close the flag and post a general civility reminder without singling anyone out."

  decide:
    course: "Close F-3318 as a civility matter with no records involved, post a general civility reminder, and log it."
    confidence: 0.8
    now: "Confirm nothing in the posts goes beyond the public page; close F-3318 with that disposition; post a short reminder of the charter's civility rule; log it."
    would_change_my_mind: "Any detail in the posts that is not on the page but is in a file Corwin holds: that is records misuse, and I report to the CO (D)."

arguments.disposition: Posts m5521-m5523 link and quote EN2 Reyna's own public fundraising page (organizer Tomas Reyna, public since 09 Oct); nothing beyond the page and no personnel record used. Not a para 6 matter. Civility reminder posted under the charter.
